story_title: As the assigned Event Coordinator, I want to withdraw a pending venue booking request or release a confirmed booking so that a venue my event no longer needs becomes available to other events

acceptance_criteria.text: The assigned Event Coordinator can withdraw a venue booking request that is still pending.
A withdrawn request no longer appears for Venue Staff to review.
The assigned Event Coordinator can release a confirmed venue booking.

Given a booking is withdrawn or released, when venue availability is next checked, then the period it occupied, including the venue's setup and turnaround time, is available for other bookings (see: Book Venues in 15-Minute Units, SPM-93).
The Coordinator can record a reason for the withdrawal or release.
A withdrawn or released booking remains on the event record with its status, and is distinguishable from pending, confirmed and rejected bookings.
Venue Staff are notified when a confirmed booking is released.
After a withdrawal or release, the event's venue arrangement is shown as outstanding (see: Track Outstanding Arrangements) and the Coordinator can request a different venue.
Users other than the assigned Coordinator cannot withdraw or release the booking.

open_questions: Written 2026-10-11 before any SPM-67 code (test-first), then checked against the built code the same day (kayalvizhi24): every label, dialog, message and badge quoted in the cases is what the Venue tab now shows. Fixture dates were moved from September to November 2027 while building, because the app writes September as 'Sept' (en-SG), so a quoted 'Sep' would not match the screen. Built: PATCH /api/events/[id]/venue-bookings/[bookingId] (withdraw or release), src/lib/venueBookingChange.ts (the rules and the Venue Staff notification), the Venue tab's buttons and dialog, the 'Released' badge, and migration 20261011120000_add_venue_booking_withdrawal (to apply with `npx prisma migrate deploy`, no reseed; `npm run fixtures:spm67` needs it applied first). No case was added from code: the only behaviour beyond the ACs (two people acting on one booking at once, a closed event) is unit-tested.

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (AC6): two new booking statuses, stored as 'withdrawn' (was Pending) and 'released' (was Approved), shown with grey badges 'Withdrawn' and 'Released'. Both are distinct from 'Pending' (amber), 'Approved' and 'Rejected' (red). The existing comment in src/lib/venueConflict.ts that says withdrawn and released would both be stored as 'cancelled' is replaced. Neither status blocks a venue or counts as a repeat request: only Pending and Approved do today, so the availability, duplicate and confirm rules need no change for AC4 and AC8.

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (AC1, AC3 wording): on the Venue tab's 'Booking requests' card, a Pending row gets a 'Withdraw request' button and an Approved row a 'Release booking' button, for the assigned Coordinator only. Withdraw dialog: title 'Withdraw this request?', text '<venue (code)> on <date, times> will no longer be requested, and Venue Staff will no longer see it on their Booking Requests list.', buttons 'Withdraw request' / 'Keep request'. Release dialog: title 'Release this booking?', text '<venue (code)> on <date, times> will be freed for other events, and Venue Staff will be notified.', buttons 'Release booking' / 'Keep booking'. Success alerts: 'Request withdrawn' - '<venue (code)> on <date, times> is now Withdrawn. You can request another venue below.' and 'Booking released' - '<venue (code)> on <date, times> is now Released. Venue Staff have been notified. You can request another venue below.'

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (AC5): the reason is optional ('can record'), in a 'Reason (optional)' box in both dialogs, up to 2,000 characters like Venue Staff's rejection reason. It is shown on the row as 'Reason for withdrawal: …' or 'Reason for release: …', and no line is shown when it was left empty (TC06). No case types 2,000+ characters: the box stops at 2,000, as the rejection reason's does. Storing it needs three new nullable columns on venue_bookings (who withdrew or released it, when, and the reason): a migration with `prisma migrate deploy`, no reseed.

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (AC7): on release, every active Venue Staff user gets a notification (notifyRole, as Venue Staff are not scoped by venue, #66): title 'Venue booking released', body '<Coordinator> released <venue (code)> for <reference> <event title> on <date, times>.' plus ' Reason: <reason>' when one was given. Withdrawing a pending request sends no notification: Venue Staff had not acted on it, and it simply leaves their list (AC2). The Notifications page is not built yet (SPM-71), so by hand AC7 is checked only through 'Venue Staff have been notified.' in TC03; the notification itself is checked by the unit tests. Add a by-hand case once SPM-71 is merged.

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (AC8): 'shown as outstanding' is checked on what exists on this branch: the Overview 'Venue' row reads 'Not booked yet' and 'Confirm event' is refused with 'This event cannot be confirmed yet: no venue is booked for this event.' (SPM-34). Track Outstanding Arrangements (SPM-33) is still on its own branch; its Readiness tab lists only Pending and Approved bookings and adds a 'No venue booked' row when none is left, so it handles a withdrawn or released booking without change. Once SPM-33 is merged, add a 'Readiness' tab step to TC05 and TC06.

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (AC9): who may see the buttons follows the request rule (canRequestVenueBooking): only the assigned Coordinator. Other Coordinators, the Ops Manager and Venue Staff see the booking list with the existing message 'Only the assigned Coordinator can request a venue booking.' and no buttons (TC08-TC10). The Event Organiser has no Venue tab (venue:view), so no case is written for them. The API refuses a withdraw or release from anyone else with 'Only the assigned Coordinator can withdraw or release a venue booking.' - reachable only by calling the API, so unit-tested, not a case.

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (races, unit-tested only): no AC covers two people acting on the same booking at once, so no manual case is written. The server still refuses both: withdrawing a request Venue Staff have just approved gives 'This request has already been approved, so it can no longer be withdrawn. Release the booking instead.', and approving or rejecting a request that has just been withdrawn gets SPM-43's existing 'This booking request has already been decided.' (only Pending can be decided). SPM-43's page and wording are not changed.

DECIDED 2026-10-11 (event status, left to the developer by the team): a booking may be withdrawn or released on any event that is not closed, and the event's status is not changed by it - a Confirmed event that releases its only room keeps 'Confirmed', as no AC asks for a status change and returning an event to Planning belongs to other stories. On a closed event (Completed, Cancelled, Rejected, Withdrawn) no button is shown, the same rule as 'Request booking' (CLOSED_EVENT_MESSAGE). Unit-tested; no manual case, to keep the set in proportion to the story.

Fixtures: scripts/seed-spm67.ts (`npm run fixtures:spm67`); the same venues and events are appended to prisma/seed.ts (events only - the script makes their bookings), modelled on scripts/seed-spm81.ts. Three test rooms, upserted and reset each run, Orchard Hub L4, max 60, theatre 60 / classroom 40, open 07:00-22:00, no facilities: 'SPM67 Hall' (SPM67-HAL, setup 30, turnaround 30), 'SPM67 Studio' (SPM67-STU, 0/0), 'SPM67 Annex' (SPM67-ANX, 0/0). Events (seed key spm67_*, Planning, 30 attendees, theatre, Rachel Ng's, assigned to Daniel Tan, no equipment): 'SPM67 Pending Pair' 2 Nov 2027 09:00-12:00 (Hall Pending, Studio Pending, Annex Approved; TC01-02); 'SPM67 Release Pair' 4 Nov 09:00-12:00 (Hall Approved, Studio Approved; TC03); 'SPM67 Held Hall' 9 Nov 10:00-12:00 (Hall Pending), 'SPM67 Booked Hall' 9 Nov 15:00-16:00 (Hall Approved) and 'SPM67 Afternoon Briefing' 9 Nov 12:15-14:15 (none; TC04); 'SPM67 Only Room' 16 Nov 09:00-12:00 (Hall Approved; TC05); 'SPM67 Fresh Start' 18 Nov 09:00-12:00 (Hall Pending; TC06); 'SPM67 Status Mix' 23 Nov 09:00-12:00 (Hall Pending, Studio Approved, Annex Rejected with reason, Hall Withdrawn with reason, Studio Released with reason; TC07-10). The reset also deletes any booking at the three SPM67 rooms, so a request made in TC04-TC06 goes with it.

SPM-81 AC7 (reminder on SPM-67, 2026-10-10): the 'other bookings unchanged' half for withdrawing and releasing is checked here - TC01 (withdraw one of two pending plus an approved one), TC02 (Venue Staff's list loses only the withdrawn request) and TC03 (release one of two approved). Once these pass, SPM-81's AC7 note can point to them.

RESOLVED 2026-10-11 (size): 13 cases were trimmed to 10 so the set matches a 2-point story with 9 ACs: the two race cases went to unit tests (no AC asks for them), and the separate withdraw and release availability cases were merged into TC04. For comparison, the other 2-point stories have 10 (SPM-34), 14 (SPM-50, SPM-54) and 20 (SPM-22), and SPM-81 (5 points) has 11.
